_provenance: Evaluated from the Chord Card (claude.ai artifact TgFMSuaPN4ZZbkp6y71cte, the K1 source of truth), function card() with its std branch: orbit .745R, r_note .19R, r_ding .2R, inner_ring .355R, depth = 2r/3, lensC = orbit - (2r - depth), main name at orbit + depth/2 on a mutant card, lens name at lensC + r - depth/2, main numbers at R + 5 (R = 66) on a mutant card and at orbit - r - .085R otherwise, M<n> at orbit - r - .085R. _angle_note: The Card draws Pygmy on its real instrument angles (290, 250, ...); HPE.layout fixture rev 3 puts every mutant card on 270, 230, ... a uniform 20 degree rotation.
